description_en: Queries the configuration information about a Hadoop cluster
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-hadoop-configs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxx --emr-instance-id c-xxx --config-name hdfs-site --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHadoopConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the configuration file. Valid values:

*   hdfs-site
*   core-site
*   yarn-site
*   mapred-site
*   hive-site
parameters.help_zh:
配置文件名称：

- hdfs-site：hdfs-site.xml文件

- core-site：core-site.xml文件

- yarn-site：yarn-site.xml文件

- mapred-site：mapred-site.xml文件

- hive-site：hive-site.xml文件
parameters.name: config_name
